inputs.text: Minimal flat vector-style logo symbol, perfectly clean geometric shapes: one stylized aspen leaf, broad rounded ovate silhouette with smooth edge, pointed tip at top, short straight stem at bottom, symmetric. Solid deep forest green leaf (#1e5b3e). Inside the leaf, the veins are a bold git commit graph knocked out in warm white: one thick vertical midrib trunk rising from the stem, splitting into exactly two thick branch veins, one to the upper left and one to the upper right, each ending in a large solid circular commit node; the top of the midrib also ends in a commit node. Three circular nodes total, two warm white and one golden-yellow (#e8b13c) at the upper-right branch tip as the only accent. Thick strokes, large nodes, generous negative space, crisp edges, flat solid fills, no gradient, no outline, centered isolated symbol on a plain solid very light warm-white background, professional desktop app icon, no lettering.
